stem: Based on paragraph 2 of the selection “A Massive Mission,” what is the most likely reason Endeavour flew to different places in California before landing at the Los Angeles International Airport?

options.label: A
options.text: To allow planners time to prepare the streets for the shuttle

options.label: B
options.text: To test whether the shuttle was still working well

options.label: C
options.text: To give more people the opportunity to view the shuttle

options.label: D
options.text: To remind people how the shuttle was previously used
